mapper.select: SELECT CAST(work_order_id AS CHAR) id,order_no orderNo,customer,CAST(factory_id AS CHAR) factoryId,CAST(production_line_id AS CHAR) productionLineId,CAST(owner_id AS CHAR) ownerId, factory_name factoryName,line_name lineName,owner_name ownerName,DATE_FORMAT(order_date,'%Y-%m-%d') orderDate,status,reject_reason rejectReason, create_by createBy,creator_name creatorName,DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createTime,version, (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metal_process_batch b WHERE b.work_order_id=metal_work_order.work_order_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metal_warehouse_order o WHERE o.work_order_id=metal_work_order.work_order_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metal_work_report r JOIN metal_work_order_item i ON i.item_id=r.item_id WHERE i.work_order_id=metal_work_order.work_order_id)) hasBusinessReferences FROM metal_work_order WHERE del_flag='0' AND factory_id=#{scopeId} ORDER BY work_order_id ASC
